account.sampleRationale: The Campbell's Company's FY2025 10-K lists 24 US manufacturing plants across Meals and Beverages and Snacks, of which we audited 20.

coverageNote.note: The Campbell's Company's FY2025 10-K lists 24 US manufacturing plants (17 Snacks, 7 Meals and Beverages). We audited 20 of them.

account.dossierIntro: Campbell's runs a hybrid CPG network: soup, snacks (Snyder's-Lance), and juice. We audited 20 of 24 US manufacturing plants. Napoleon OH is 175 acres of soup manufacturing. Snyder's Hanover PA is the snack production engine. 690 dock doors and 1,789 trailer spots. YardFlow runs the soup, snack, and juice flows as distinct queues without forcing one operating protocol on all three.
surprisingFindings: Napoleon OH is 175 acres of soup manufacturing. Largest single soup plant in North America.
2 of 20 audited sites are rail-served. Campbell's has shifted away from rail in the last decade.
Snyder's Hanover PA runs 45 docks for snack production. Different unit economics than soup.

sites.name: Campbell's Soup - Maxton NC
sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster coordinates (34.771797, -79.325047) landed inside the plant footprint.
Satellite probes z16-18 around that point revealed a very large industrial
manufacturing campus surrounded by pine forest, consistent with a thermal/
aseptic soup plant. Street View on NC-71 N confirmed a Campbell's-branded
property sign and chain-link perimeter fence facing the highway. This is the
Campbell's Maxton soup plant — site of the named $150M aseptic soup expansion.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off NC-71 N; entrance road splits, guarded checkpoint visible at z20-21 ~34.7743,-79.3231
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small guard-booth structure with dark roof at the checkpoint apron, ~1-vehicle footprint, confirmed at z21
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Sprawling campus, docks distributed across multiple building faces; ~40 estimate is low-confidence, banded 25-50
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large drop yard south of plant, 8+ rows packed with parked trailers (80-100+)
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 8+ connected/separate buildings: process halls, silos, warehouses
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron off the highway with room for additional lanes
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~1060m N-S x ~700m E-W of fenced/cleared area

citations.claim: Completed 88,000-sq-ft Maxton expansion with two new aseptic lines (+20% capacity, ~100 jobs); plant operating since 1979 for soup/broth.

verification.rationale: Campbell's own newsroom (days old) confirms active operation plus a just-completed aseptic expansion; zero negative signal.

sites.name: Campbell's Soup - Napoleon OH

fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively identified on public-road Street View frontage (all visible frontage is employee parking behind fence). Marked false / remoteGs true at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer parking on the NE side (130+ trailers, third-party carriers: Western Express, Marten, etc.) plus rows along the south road.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Multiple dock banks across NE warehouse faces and central buildings; ~55 estimate banded 50+, low confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on separate building faces (NE warehouse vs central plant docks).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large campus: production halls, big NE distribution warehouse, wastewater treatment plant with multiple digester domes.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal yard aprons with ample paved width.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~890m N-S x ~830m E-W.

citations.claim: Campbell's shifting RTS soup production from Paris TX to its Napoleon OH and Maxton NC plants (Napoleon a continuing/growing soup plant).

verification.rationale: Campbell's largest soup/V8 plant, actively hiring in 2026 and a named destination for consolidated Paris soup volume; no negative.

sites.name: Campbell's - Paris TX
